method: Per context, the measured field strings of every case are hashed in Figma (FNV-1a of the sorted key=fields lines) and compared with the same strings built from computed.json; an equal hash proves each field equal, so observed repeats expected in its Figma form (hex color, number); a differing context is detailed field by field.
